column2: Escaped output names in exportOutput and diagnostic messages using shell-safe quoting helpers.
Escaped diagnostic and exportOutput strings using shell-safe quoting helpers.
Steps with no operations now receive a default 'echo no operations' script entry.
computeLevel now throws GitlabTargetError LOWER_FAILED when a dependency cycle is detected.
emit.ts rejects job IDs that conflict with reserved top-level GitLab CI keys.
Removed dependencies emission; needs carries all scheduling and artifact dependencies as an array.
GitlabJob.artifacts is now a single { paths?, reports? } object emitted directly as a mapping.
lowerGitlab now rejects multi-pipeline graphs with INVALID_GRAPH before selecting pipelines[0].
lowerGitlab filters emitted jobs to steps reachable from entry roots.
lowerTriggers now preserves branch filters in generated GitLab if conditions.
exportOutput writes to sverka.env and emits artifacts.reports.dotenv for downstream propagation.
Diagnostic text is emitted inside single quotes with safe single-quote escaping.
Removed dependencies field; needs includes all control, value, and artifact producers.
collectVariables now skips secret inputs so defaults are not serialized as plaintext variables.
GitlabTarget now implements the Target contract with readonly name and compile(graph).
Repository convention uses numbered spec directories with a spec.md file, matching all existing specs.
emit.ts now always emits needs and dependencies as arrays of strings.
Artifacts are modeled as a single { paths?, reports? } object and emitted as a YAML mapping.
Stages are derived from used topological levels in dependency order (build, stage-1, ...).
importArtifact producers are resolved through jobIdMap, handling slashes and de-duplicated IDs.
Tests parse YAML and assert on properties; the parse result type is acceptable for test expectations.
lowerGitlab rejects projects with more than one pipeline.
lowerGitlab only lowers steps reachable from entry roots.
Spec and types updated so artifacts are a single mapping with paths and dotenv reports.
Spec updated: scalar outputs use sverka.env dotenv reports and artifacts are emitted as a mapping.
